title: Full Body Mobility
description: TRX-assisted mobility — five holds, about ten minutes.
transcript:
Mobility finisher — five TRX-assisted holds, about ten minutes. Breathe slowly and ease into each stretch. Don't force range you don't have today. <break time="3s" />

Deep squat hold with thoracic reach. Hold both handles, sink into the deepest comfortable squat — heels planted.

Settle in and breathe. Soften the jaw. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty

<break time="3s" />

Reach one arm toward the ceiling — rotate through the chest and upper back.

Long spine — easy inhale. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty

<break time="3s" />

Other arm up. Same squat depth, heels down.

Open through the ribs. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty

<break time="3s" />

Back to the first side — long spine, easy breath.

Heavy in the heels. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty

<break time="3s" />

Switch again. Open through the rib cage.

No forcing — just explore the range. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty

<break time="3s" />

Last twenty — stay soft in the hips. <break time="3s" />

Next — chest opener. Turn around when you're ready.

Face away from the anchor, arms out holding the straps. Lean forward until you feel a stretch across the chest.

Settle in. Slow exhales. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

<break time="3s" />

Arms a little higher — new line of stretch.

Shoulders melt down. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

<break time="3s" />

Arms slightly lower now — still breathing slowly.

Stay patient — no bouncing. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

<break time="3s" />

Last thirty — don't chase intensity, just hold. <break time="3s" />

Next — lat stretch. Face the anchor.

Arms straight overhead, straps taut. Sit the hips back and drop the chest toward the floor — long spine, weight in the heels.

Settle in. Breathe into the sides of the ribs. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

<break time="3s" />

Keep breathing — soften the ribs down.

Arms stay long — don't shrug. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

<break time="3s" />

Halfway — stay long, no collapsing.

Heavy hips, light head. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

<break time="3s" />

Last thirty — easy neck, slow exhales. <break time="3s" />

Next — hamstring stretch.

One heel slightly forward. Hold the handles and hinge at the hips with a flat back.

First side. Settle in — micro-bend the knee if you need it. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five <break time="3s" /> Forty <break time="3s" /> Forty-five <break time="3s" /> Fifty <break time="3s" /> Fifty-five <break time="3s" /> Sixty

<break time="3s" />

Switch sides — other leg forward, same flat-back hinge.

Find the stretch, not the strain. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five <break time="3s" /> Forty <break time="3s" /> Forty-five <break time="3s" /> Fifty <break time="3s" /> Fifty-five <break time="3s" /> Sixty

<break time="3s" />

Last hold — hip flexor lunge.

Split stance, rear knee dropping. Reach the same-side arm overhead and slightly across.

First side. Find the stretch — slight pelvic tuck. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five <break time="3s" /> Forty <break time="3s" /> Forty-five <break time="3s" /> Fifty <break time="3s" /> Fifty-five <break time="3s" /> Sixty

<break time="3s" />

Switch sides — other leg forward, same reach.

Breathe into the front of the hip. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five <break time="3s" /> Forty <break time="3s" /> Forty-five <break time="3s" /> Fifty <break time="3s" /> Fifty-five <break time="3s" /> Sixty

<break time="3s" />

Mobility complete. Great session today. Slow breath in — and out. <break time="3s" />
